headlines.title: Three billionaires called the AI top. Each has a reason to.
headlines.summary: Elon Musk, Ken Griffin and Chamath Palihapitiya all called the top of the AI trade in the same week, as CoreWeave, Nebius and IREN fell more than 30% in a month. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down what's true, who's talking their book, and what investors should actually worry about, from idle GPUs to a closing debt window.

headlines.title: What Is Qualcomm (QCOM) Signaling With Its BlueChip Government Laptop Push?
headlines.summary: QUALCOMM (NasdaqGS:QCOM) and defense technology contractor Anduril are launching a US-focused BlueChip laptop for government and first responders in 2026. The BlueChip device is positioned as a secure, US-assembled system with a supply chain centered on domestic components and manufacturing partners. QUALCOMM is pairing the BlueChip rollout with new custom AI and 5G ASIC design capabilities linked to its Alphawave IP acquisition.

headlines.title: Qualcomm’s Layoff Notices Start in November. A 2026 Bonus Paid in January Shouldn’t Count Against His $25,560 Social Security Earnings Limit
headlines.summary: A January paycheck stuffed with a bonus, unused vacation, and severance looks like a Social Security trap for a newly retired engineer, but the earnings test has a lesser-known rule that could change everything about how that money gets counted.

headlines.title: Anduril and Qualcomm launch BlueChip to onshore computer manufacturing
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Defense technology startup Anduril Industries has partnered with Qualcomm Incorporated (NASDAQ:QCOM) to launch BlueChip, a new hardware initiative aimed at designing and manufacturing personal computers entirely within the United States. Unveiled on Tuesday, the collaboration focuses on producing secure, domestic laptops tailored for defense, public safety, and government agencies seeking to mitigate overseas supply chain vulnerabilities.

headlines.title: Qualcomm Pledges Global Layoffs as Handset Revenue Falls 20%: “Stronger Performance Culture”
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysQualcomm will notify employees of global, performance-based job cuts starting in November, but CEO Cristiano Amon’s memo gave no headcount. Handset revenue fell 20% to $5.

description: QUALCOMM Incorporated engages in the development and commercialization of foundational technologies for the wireless industry worldwide. It operates through three segments: Qualcomm CDMA Technologies (QCT); Qualcomm Technology Licensing (QTL); and Qualcomm Strategic Initiatives (QSI). The QCT segment develops and supplies integrated circuits and system software with connectivity and computing technologies for use in mobile devices; automotive systems for connectivity, digital cockpit, and ADAS/AD; and IoT, including consumer electronic devices, industrial devices, and edge networking products. The QTL segment grants licenses or provides rights to use portions of its intellectual property portfolio, which include various patent rights useful in the manufacture and sale of wireless products comprising products implementing LTE, and/or OFDMA-based 5G products and derivatives; to use cellular standard-essential patents, including 3G, 4G and 5G for cellular devices. The QSI segment invests in early-stage companies in various industries, including 5G, artificial intelligence, automotive, consumer, enterprise, cloud, IoT, and extended reality, and investments, including non-marketable equity securities and, to a lesser extent, marketable equity securities, and convertible debt instruments. It also provides development, and other services and sells related products to the United States government agencies and their contractors. In addition, the company is also involved in Qualcomm government technologies and data center businesses. Further, it provides security and intelligence services for unmanaged networks through software-based network security solutions. The company is in collaboration with Amazon to enable customized silicon at scale for large-scale AI data centers. QUALCOMM Incorporated was incorporated in 1985 and is headquartered in San Diego, California.
